lines: ARVIND KONDANGI LAKSHMIKUMAR, role unknown, is selling 1,150,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹80.50 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are estimated at ₹267.29 crore at offer price, so more value remains with them after this sale.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition not confirmed from the documents.
